newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher in wake of late Dow gain.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher in wake of late Dow gain.

text.p: UK shares opened higher on Wednesday after a strong performance on Wall Street and as a weakening pound eased pressure on the overseas earnings of major exporting stocks, dealers said.
Yet trading was expected to be cautious ahead of economic indicators later in the session including UK retail sales and U.S. consumer prices.
The FTSE 100 index was up 10.9 points at 4,343.2 shortly after the start of trading, with SmithKline Beecham leading drug stocks higher amid positive comment on yesterday's results.
